title: AIAX Capability Section (Tier 1)
description: A single capability section at /aiax/sections/<section_id>.json. Target size: 200-1,000 tokens.

section_id.description: Matches the entry_points[].id in the Tier 0 manifest.

purpose.description: One-paragraph description of what this capability does.

oneOf.description: Inline JSON Schema for the input.
Prose description (use only if JSON Schema is not yet authored).
Inline JSON Schema for the output.

model.description: Pricing model: per_call, per_minute, per_token, flat, free, subscription.

amount.description: Amount as a string to preserve precision.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. USDC, USD, ETH, EUR).

rail.description: Payment rail (e.g. x402, usdc-base, stripe, lightning).

pact_mandate_template.description: URL to a PACT mandate template that pre-fills negotiation parameters for this capability.

mcp_tool_name.description: Name of the MCP tool that performs this capability (Tier 2 binding).

openapi_operation_id.description: operationId from the OpenAPI document, if this capability has a REST equivalent.

latency_p50_ms.description: Measured p50 response latency in milliseconds.

latency_p99_ms.description: Measured p99 response latency in milliseconds.
